messages:
Maya Chen: Quick sync — Datadog + OpenTelemetry joint launch checklist. We need to lock the dashboard bundle, reference OTLP mapping, a sample app for private deploys, and press embargo timing. High level: partner readiness, docs, QA, demo creds.

Jorge Rivera: On OTLP mapping — do we have the recommended resource attributes and span naming conventions? I can draft a concordance doc. Also sampling guidance (client vs collector) to avoid trace deluge.

Priya Patel: For the dashboard, product wants these KPIs visible by default: request latency P50/P95, tokens/sec, model fallback counts, cache hit rate. Can we expose those as tags for Datadog dashboards?

Samir Khan: I can add docs snippets and the sample app. Need a small envoy + otel-collector config for the private package. Example we plan to include:
```
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc: 
processors:
  batch:
exporters:
  otlp/remote:
    endpoint: "https://ingest.datadoghq.com"
service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [otlp/remote]
```
Will that work for the SI kits?

Kevin Liu: Timeline check — partner asks for GA asset drop + press embargo 2 weeks after we hand off dashboards. Is team comfortable with a 14-day marketing buffer? Also need partner logo lock and legal review.

Maya Chen: 14 days is tight but doable if eng QA + docs are ready in 5 business days. Action items: Jorge — OTLP mapping doc (due Fri), Samir — sample app + envoy config (due Mon), Priya — dashboard wire (due Wed), Kevin — legal/press check (engage legal today). I'll coordinate partner PM. :clipboard: @obs-bot can you add these to the partnership board?

obs-bot: Created checklist card: "Datadog+OTel joint launch" and assigned to Maya Chen, Jorge Rivera, Priya Patel, Samir Khan, Kevin Liu. Due date set to 1769998000.

Jorge Rivera: One more - we should include a short troubleshooting section for dropped spans / high cardinality metrics. I'll put common queries and sampling toggles.

Samir Khan: Noted. I'll include a small troubleshooting playbook + curl examples to verify traces. E.g.:
```
curl -X POST https://collector.redwood.local/v1/traces -H 'Content-Type: application/json' --data-binary @trace.json
```

Priya Patel: Also request a screenshot pack for marketing (desktop + mobile dashboard views). Partner wants 2 variations (light/dark).

Kevin Liu: I'll ping partner design and legal now. Also confirming private-deploy demo creds — partner wants ephemeral keys for customer demos only. We'll use short-lived tokens via the console.

Maya Chen: Great. Let's do a dry-run demo next Wed 10:30am PT — please block calendar. We'll rehearse the onboarding flow, dashboard, and fallback behavior. If all green, we start embargo countdown. :rocket:

Samir Khan: Blocked. I'll record the session and capture notes for the SI kit.

Kevin Liu: Thx — I'll get press checklist and logo approvals started.

Maya Chen: Perfect — thanks team. Small follow-up: confirm whether any telemetry PII redaction is required for partner samples (privacy/legal). If yes, we'll sanitize sample traces.

Jorge Rivera: I'll add an example redaction rule to the OTEL pipeline doc.

Maya Chen: Awesome. Closing loop tomorrow with a short status ping. Thanks everyone! :tada:
